name: impact-sponsor-impact-one-pager
description: Drafts a Sponsor Impact One-Pager from evidence you already hold, producing the answer and the decision asked in the first two lines, a table of each agreed measure against what happened, and short lists of what changed, what did not, what is unknown, what helped and what blocked. Use for "run impact-sponsor-impact-one-pager", "one page summary for the sponsor", "training impact report", "training evaluation report", "report training results to the sponsor", "executive summary of training results", "bottom line up front", "what do I tell the sponsor", part of the Claude Guide for Training Impact Pack by 90n.
